stories.title: Blood Ties
stories.tagline: Two powerful families tied by blood, torn apart by greed.
stories.synopsis: When the matriarch of the mighty Khumalo dynasty collapses at the annual Sandton gala, a hidden will surfaces that names a secret daughter as the sole heir. Betrayal, boardroom warfare, and family secrets collide in Johannesburg's most dramatic showdown.

episodes.title: The Golden Will
episodes.synopsis: The reading of the matriarch's will shocks Sandton elite as an unknown daughter walks in.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Who authorized her DNA test before the funeral?

episodes.title: The Secret Vault
episodes.synopsis: A midnight confrontation in the Khumalo mansion exposes a 20-year pact.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The safe was already emptied before midnight.

episodes.title: The Poisoned Goblet
episodes.synopsis: An ally in the boardroom turns into the deadliest rival.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Drink it, or sign the shares over now.

episodes.title: Bloodline War
episodes.synopsis: The true royal elder convenes an emergency tribal council in KwaZulu-Natal.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The chief holds the original birth certificate.

episodes.title: The Secret Will Revealed
episodes.synopsis: The hidden codicil is presented at midnight, catching the Khumalo board off guard.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Who authorized her DNA test before the funeral?

stories.title: The CEO's Secret Wife
stories.tagline: A fake marriage. A hidden identity. A love that could ruin everything.
stories.synopsis: To save her family's heritage estate from foreclosure, Zandile agrees to a 1-year secret contract marriage with Sandile Ndlovu, Johannesburg's most feared billionaire CEO. But behind closed doors in his Clifton penthouse, cold business turns into undeniable, forbidden passion.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Sandile presents an offer Zandile cannot refuse: 50 million Rand and a ring, with strictly no feelings attached.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Sign before the clock strikes midnight.

episodes.title: The Contract
episodes.synopsis: Clause 7: You must act as the devoted wife in front of the board and media at all costs.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Who leaked our marriage certificate to the press?

episodes.title: The Arrangement
episodes.synopsis: Moving into the penthouse brings unexpected intimacy and lurking enemies.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: His ex-fiancée arrives with an unexpected key.

episodes.title: The Unexpected Kiss
episodes.synopsis: Trapped in an elevator during a storm, the facade falls away completely.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: This wasn't part of the contract.

episodes.title: The Queen Mother’s Ultimatum
episodes.synopsis: The ancient council convenes at midnight in the royal estate to deliver their final decision on the amber throne.

stories.title: Zulu Love Story
stories.tagline: Two worlds. One unforgettable royal heartbeat.
stories.synopsis: Prince Sipho of the KwaZulu royal line meets Nandi, an edgy streetwear designer from Braamfontein. When ancestral duty calls him home to an arranged marriage, will he choose the crown or true love?

episodes.title: Eyes in Braamfontein
episodes.synopsis: A pop-up fashion show in Johannesburg brings two completely different souls face to face.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: He didn't mention he was a prince.

stories.title: Broken Vows
stories.tagline: Every secret comes with a price in high society.
stories.synopsis: During an ultra-glamorous 10th-anniversary ball in Sandton, an anonymous caller plays a secret recording that exposes betrayal, money laundering, and an unspoken pact from 2014.

episodes.title: The Anniversary Toast
episodes.synopsis: A crystal champagne glass shatters as the projector reveals evidence no one was meant to see.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Who switched the USB drive at the podium?

stories.title: The Hustlers
stories.tagline: From Soweto streets to Sandton skyscrapers.
stories.synopsis: Three ambitious street hustlers from Soweto execute a daring high-tech takeover of Johannesburg's biggest private gold bullion syndicate.

episodes.title: The Gold Blueprint
episodes.synopsis: A secret meeting in Maboneng uncovers the security codes to the Carlton Centre underground vault.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The alarm just triggered 3 minutes early.

stories.title: Campus Royals
stories.tagline: Privilege, power, and secret society scandals.
stories.synopsis: At an elite Cape Town university, the secret student council decides who rises and who falls. A fearless scholarship student vows to tear down the dynasty from within.

episodes.title: The Induction
episodes.synopsis: The midnight bell rings at Jameson Hall as the masked council initiates the chosen few.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: She refused to take the loyalty oath.

stories.title: Barrio Billionaire
stories.tagline: Built from nothing. Feared by everyone.
stories.synopsis: From a tiny spaza shop in Soweto to commanding Africa's most valuable fintech empire, Thabo faces old-money families trying to take his company down.

episodes.title: The Hostile Takeover
episodes.synopsis: Sandton investment bankers laugh at Thabo's valuation—until his app clears 10 million transactions overnight.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: We own 51% of your bank as of 9 AM.

stories.title: Heist Game
stories.tagline: One night. Zero room for error.
stories.synopsis: An elite crew of cybersecurity prodigies and street specialists plan an impossible raid on a subterranean Cape Town vault during the New Year's Eve gala.

episodes.title: The Countdown Begins
episodes.synopsis: The laser grid trips in the penthouse, giving the crew exactly 60 seconds to bypass the biometric vault.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The lasers didn't shut down.

stories.title: Queen of Jozi
stories.tagline: One woman's ruthless rise to the top of Johannesburg's underworld.
stories.synopsis: When her husband's gold syndication empire falls into rival hands, Nina Khumalo steps from the shadows to reclaim the throne in Sandton. Boardroom power plays meet street warfare in South Africa's most anticipated micro-drama.

episodes.title: The Golden Takeover
episodes.synopsis: Nina walks into the Sandton boardroom as the rival syndicate votes to liquidate her family's mining assets.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: Who signed over 51% of the shares before sunrise?

episodes.title: Midnight in Rosebank
episodes.synopsis: A tense standoff at the penthouse reveals an undercover mole inside the private security team.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The security feed was hacked from inside the room.

stories.title: Umembeso: Royal Secrets
stories.tagline: A traditional royal wedding where every gift carries a deadly secret.
stories.synopsis: During the opulent royal dowry ceremony in KwaZulu-Natal, an ancient family talisman is stolen, threatening to expose a thirty-year bloodline deception before the vows are sealed.

episodes.title: The Stolen Talisman
episodes.synopsis: The royal elders open the sacred chest to discover the ancestral spearhead has been replaced with a warning note.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The note is written in the King's own handwriting.

stories.title: Lagos Confidential
stories.tagline: High-tech corporate espionage across Victoria Island.
stories.synopsis: A brilliant forensic hacker uncovers a multi-billion naira offshore conduit on the eve of West Africa's biggest telecom merger. With assassins on his trail, 60 seconds is all he has to leak the truth.

episodes.title: The Decryption Key
episodes.synopsis: A rooftop server room in Ikoyi is breached 15 minutes before the boardroom press conference.
episodes.cliffhanger_hook: The server just self-destructed and transmitted the coordinates.
